title: StockSmart Sourcing Desk Schedule — Supply Cover for Special Stock and Backordered Items in Converted Bins
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — customer-owned fill-to level of a bin converted from consignment at a par review.**

**Rule.** The converted item's supply adds cover: an item that any of its bin entries flags as special stock adds 2 weeks, any other item backordered at the program's ship-to in the last six months adds 1 week, and any other item adds none.

**Records.** The program's bin entries carrying the item, any of which may flag it as special stock; and the backorder lines of the item on the order history of the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account, of age below six months (a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month).

| Any bin entry flags the item special stock | Backordered at the ship-to in the last six months | Supply cover |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | 2 weeks |
| no | yes | 1 week |
| no | no | none |

The special stock flag decides first; a backorder adds 1 week only for an item no bin entry flags as special stock.
